tools.name: run_seat_map_rebuild
tools.description: Runs the venue seat-map rebuild job for an event, which recomputes the seating layout from the venue configuration. Returns the job's exit status and output.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Identifier of the event whose seat map should be rebuilt.

params.name: venue_config
params.description: Name of the venue configuration to rebuild from, e.g. 'standard' or 'in-the-round'.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum time to let the job run before it is stopped.

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing-ops")

SEATMAP_SCRIPT = os.environ.get("SEATMAP_SCRIPT", "/opt/ticketing/bin/rebuild_seatmap.py")
PYTHON_BIN = os.environ.get("TICKETING_PYTHON", "/opt/ticketing/venv/bin/python")
ALLOWED_CONFIGS = {"standard", "in-the-round", "general-admission", "theater"}


@dataclass
class SeatMapRebuildResult:
    event_id: str
    venue_config: str
    exit_code: int
    succeeded: bool
    stdout_tail: str
    stderr_tail: str
    timed_out: bool = False


def _tail(text: str, lines: int = 20) -> str:
    return "\n".join((text or "").strip().splitlines()[-lines:])


@mcp.tool()
def run_seat_map_rebuild(event_id: str, venue_config: str = "standard", timeout_seconds: int = 300) -> dict:
    if not event_id or not event_id.replace("-", "").isalnum():
        raise ValueError("event_id must be alphanumeric")
    if venue_config not in ALLOWED_CONFIGS:
        raise ValueError(f"venue_config must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_CONFIGS)}")
    timeout_seconds = max(10, min(int(timeout_seconds), 1800))

    cmd = [
        PYTHON_BIN,
        SEATMAP_SCRIPT,
        "--event",
        event_id,
        "--config",
        venue_config,
    ]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=timeout_seconds,
            check=False,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        result = SeatMapRebuildResult(
            event_id=event_id,
            venue_config=venue_config,
            exit_code=-1,
            succeeded=False,
            stdout_tail=_tail(exc.stdout if isinstance(exc.stdout, str) else ""),
            stderr_tail=_tail(exc.stderr if isinstance(exc.stderr, str) else ""),
            timed_out=True,
        )
        return asdict(result)

    result = SeatMapRebuildResult(
        event_id=event_id,
        venue_config=venue_config,
        exit_code=proc.returncode,
        succeeded=proc.returncode == 0,
        stdout_tail=_tail(proc.stdout),
        stderr_tail=_tail(proc.stderr),
    )
    return asdict(result)

tools.name: release_seat_hold
tools.description: Removes a temporary seat hold for an event, permanently discarding the hold so the seats go back on sale.

params.name: hold_id
params.description: Identifier of the seat hold to release.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TICKETING_DB", "/var/lib/ticketing/orders.db")


def _delete_hold(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hold_id: str) -> int:
    with conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM hold_seats WHERE hold_id = ?", (hold_id,))
        return conn.execute("DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE id = ?", (hold_id,)).rowcount


@tool
def release_seat_hold(hold_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        removed = _delete_hold(conn, hold_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return f"Released hold {hold_id}" if removed else f"No hold found with id {hold_id}"
